purpose: Primary sources used for scene-editor reliability research; no claim that Cities Skylines uses these internal algorithms.

sources.title: Shewchuk robust predicates
sources.evidence: Adaptive orientation/incircle predicates; robust signs do not guarantee robust constructions or recover quantized inputs.

sources.title: Clipper2 Robustness
sources.evidence: Integer scaling has quantization; tiny edges and near-zero areas need explicit dimensional policy, not a blanket tolerance increase.

sources.title: Godot Large world coordinates
sources.evidence: Default GDScript float and Vector precision differ; global double precision has cost and compatibility implications.

sources.title: JSON Schema Numeric types
sources.evidence: 1 and 1.0 are the same numerical value; strings remain distinct.

sources.title: JSON Schema Annotations
sources.evidence: default is an annotation and does not populate missing fields during validation.

sources.title: OpenUSD Pcp dependencies
sources.evidence: Dependency-aware change collection; applying changes and invalidating caches is distinct from collecting effects.

sources.title: OpenUSD PcpChanges
sources.evidence: Computes needed cache changes first, Apply performs them. This is not a guarantee of RMMO transaction atomicity.

sources.title: OpenUSD ObjectsChanged
sources.evidence: Structural resync differs from nonstructural changes; arbitrary relationships are not automatically propagated.

sources.title: Epic PCG Generation Modes
sources.evidence: Partition/hierarchical generation; finer grids can duplicate work. Reference architecture, not direct Godot implementation.

sources.title: CGAL Minkowski sum 3
sources.evidence: Fixed-orientation translation configuration obstacles. Start with limited local footprints and heights, not general 3D operations.

sources.title: CGAL AABB tree
sources.evidence: Hierarchy narrows candidates; primitive intersection IDs can explain conflicts. Point distance is not continuous support proof.

sources.title: Recast rcConfig
sources.evidence: Radius, height, climb and slope are separate agent constraints; discretization and physical readiness remain separate.

project_inferences: Semantic support / occupied geometry / traversal envelopes are separate contracts.
A bounded candidate solver must be followed by complete version-matched validation; search exhaustion is not proof of global infeasibility.

For intersecting XZ cells where both height surfaces are affine, height difference extrema occur at polygon vertices; explicit coverage/hole checks remain necessary. This is a proposed project derivation, not a ready-made CGAL terrain API.
Editing source records is limited to the explicit edit set; dependency closure permits derived recomputation, not arbitrary source deletion.
